cohort: 150 pregnant women with singleton pregnancy, cephalic presentation at 34-40 weeks of gestation, and oligohydramnios.
finding: Oligohydramnios was associated with higher rates of growth retardation and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were higher in women with oligohydramnios, often due to fetal distress from cord compression or IUGR.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (mentioned as a cause of death in 2 neonates)
